description: The plot illustrates MRR@10 performance as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S) for four DPR variants. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S).” and uses a linear scale with integer values from 1 to 10 (ticks shown at regular integer intervals). The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with labeled ticks at 0.5 increments (33.0, 33.5, 34.0, 34.5, 35.5, 36.0). A black solid horizontal line (no markers) labeled “DPR w/o query” stays constant across all S at approximately 34.25. A red solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ corpus expansion” rises from about 35.15 at S=1 to about 35.55 at S=2, then continues with small increases to around 35.78–35.80 by S=7, shows a slight dip near S=8 (~35.75), and ends near ~35.78 at S=10. A green solid line with upward triangle markers labeled “DPR w/ document expansion” stays near 34.8–34.9 across S, starting around 34.78 at S=1, reaching about 34.90 at S=2, remaining close to ~34.88–34.92 through S=5, peaking around ~34.95 at S=6, and ending near ~34.88 at S=10. A blue solid line with star markers labeled “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion” fluctuates around the mid–34s, starting near ~34.75 at S=1, reaching ~34.95 at S=2, dropping to ~34.65 at S=3, rising to ~34.98 at S=5, then generally declining with small oscillations to about ~34.38 at S=10.
